name: Nom cho Vinh
summary: Nộm chợ Vinh is a mixed salad of green papaya, banana flower, bean sprouts, and green star fruit. It tastes nutty, sour, hot, salty, and sweet.
origin: Chợ Vinh and the other markets in the city, on the city introduction.
taste: The city introduction says the mixed plate tastes nutty, sour, hot, salty, and sweet.
howToEat: The city introduction shreds green papaya like glass noodles and banana flower the same way, rubs them, soaks them in light salt water, drains them, and mixes in thin green star fruit and bean sprouts. The seasonings it counts to nine are a little vinegar if the star fruit is not sour enough, a little sugar, chili, thin lime leaf, thin húng quế, crushed roasted peanuts, bột canh, and seasoning powder. It says the plate is nutty, sour, hot, salty, and sweet. Some people add boiled pork skin cut like toothpicks.
where: Chợ Vinh, and the city introduction says the salads are sold at markets in the city. A stall is not named. The hour is Check on arrival.
